newsitem.title: USA: Gunmen open fire at New York birthday party.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen open fire at New York birthday party.

text.p: Three gunmen burst into the Owl Club in the Springfield Gardens section of Queens early Sunday and sprayed bullets into a crowd celebrating a birthday, killing one man and wounding 11 others, police said.
Police identified the dead man as William Beamon, 30. Another man and a woman were in critical condition; nine others were in stable condition.
The suspects escaped. Police said they know of no motive for the shooting.
